THE MARGIN EXISTS ONLY ON THE MiB READING AND I SAY SO: 253,105,932 B is below 262,144,000 (250 MiB) but ABOVE 250,000,000 (250 MB decimal). The halves fix 262,144,000 and say the smaller governs IF THE ACTOR MEETS ONE. I looked: service-quotas get 'Deployment package size (unzipped)' returns value=250.0 unit=Megabytes (code L-E49FF7B8), which restates the same ambiguity and settles nothing. So no smaller figure has been MET, and the decisive read is Lambda's own response at the apply: an oversize package is rejected at the function update, which leaves the running code untouched. If that refusal comes, it IS the smaller figure met, limb 2 fires and this entry closes ABANDONED.
